verdict.rationale: Gemini in BigQuery provides an in-product natural-language assistant that generates/suggests SQL and Python code and explains existing queries, plus conversational analytics for chatting with data (docs-3,4,5,39,66,21,13). This matches the story of a built-in assistant writing, fixing, and explaining SQL from natural language directly inside the product. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports specifically validating the assistant's SQL-writing/fixing/explaining quality (only vendor docs cited).
